title: Conceptual overview: the living review pipeline
text: Set create_metawoRld(), add_person(), adjust forms criteria. Identify records: add_search() add_records() (DataFindR’s df_search_pubmed() ). Screen: add_screening() stores person’s (tool’s) decision; screening_status() shows conflicts; prisma_counts() feeds PRISMA diagram. Extract: channel calls submit_study(). Invalid data refused every problem listed; plausibility checks _rules.yml recorded warnings. Accept: accept_submission() single extraction, compare_extractions() reconcile() dual extraction. provenance.csv records extraction value came others agreed. Verify values papers review_values(). Decisions tied hash values, changed value returns queue. Check check_project(), locally CI (use_github_action_check()). recomputes file hashes datapackage.json, data edited outside metawoRld caught. Analyse publish run_all_meta_analyses() generate_website(); release versions signed Git tags archived Zenodo.
